source_type_precision.disposition: Current product-emitted values are a lossless subset of the exact B8 shared range. The B8 mapping does not claim that the current Source JSON Schema declares an int64 maximum.

boundary_requirements.requirement: Accept exact valid non-control UTF-8 at 1 and 64 Source bytes; reject empty, 65-byte and control-character values.
boundary_requirements.reason: Current Go validator uses byte length; JSON Schema maxLength alone is not sufficient evidence for multibyte boundaries.

boundary_requirements.requirement: Map positive org/project IDs to canonical decimal strings; reject zero, negative, sign, whitespace and leading zero shared forms.
boundary_requirements.reason: Scoped identity is mandatory and lossless.

boundary_requirements.requirement: Cover 0, 2^53-1, 2^53, 9223372036854775807, leading zero, negative, decimal point, exponent, whitespace and max+1.
boundary_requirements.reason: Cross-language decimal-string mapping must not round or coerce.

boundary_requirements.requirement: Require uncached_prompt_tokens + cache_read_tokens + cache_creation_tokens = prompt_tokens without overflow.
boundary_requirements.reason: Current Source invariant must survive shared mapping.

boundary_requirements.requirement: Preserve exact canonical calculated/charged decimal strings, CNY, micro-cny.v1 and amount_scale 1000000; reject sign, leading zero, decimal, exponent and overlength.
boundary_requirements.reason: No recalculation, unit change or floating point.

boundary_requirements.requirement: Cover whole second, nonzero microsecond and offset-to-UTC shared formatting; Source producer truncates to microseconds before Snapshot persistence.
boundary_requirements.reason: Shared formatting changes no Source instant or Snapshot hash.

boundary_requirements.requirement: Accept only settled and cancelled and prove both map to one model.request.completed event family.
Require the four exact Source gaps/reason, reject missing/duplicate/unsupported values, preserve Source bytes/order and independently prove shared affected_claim sorting.
boundary_requirements.reason: Shared canonical order must not rewrite Source Snapshot bytes.

boundary_requirements.requirement: Hash exact immutable Source Snapshot bytes and reject any Feed item whose declared snapshot_sha256 differs.
boundary_requirements.reason: Source and Envelope hash domains are separate.

boundary_requirements.requirement: Reject mismatch between Feed wrapper and Snapshot request_id, terminal status, terminal instant or revision; require timeline_complete=true.
Reject non-NFC protocol constants but preserve exact valid Source opaque UTF-8 bytes without normalization.
Reject duplicate JSON keys at every depth before ordinary object decoding in the shared mapping/conformance path.
boundary_requirements.reason: Current generated Source bytes contain no duplicate keys, but ordinary Go map/struct decoding is not duplicate-key evidence.

boundary_requirements.requirement: Reject prompt, response, authorization, api_key, credential, ip_address and upstream_error raw keys at any depth.
Prove page cursor, high-watermark, generated/fetch/receive time, retry and receiver acknowledgement do not alter Event identity, shared idempotency, Envelope hash or item-linked provenance.
boundary_requirements.reason: Delivery state is outside the Event.

boundary_requirements.requirement: Prove same scoped identity/same canonical content is duplicate-no-op and same scoped identity/different content fails closed.
boundary_requirements.reason: Reference V1 never overwrites an accepted event identity.

runtime_nonclaims: No live Source data was read.
No credential, cursor, Checkpoint or database state was read or changed.
No shared Schema or fixture is created or edited by this Source seed declaration.
The Source seeds are immutable compatibility inputs; accepted Go and TypeScript B6 conformance evidence remains separately pinned.
